content.comment_body: Hello! I have a PT1000 2-wire sensor and an [product_name] module. My sensor's range is -50 to 450°C. Is it possible to measure this full range, or is 200°C the maximum supported by the module?

The [product_name] module supports a measurement range from -50 to 200°C, and this limit cannot be changed. To measure from -50 to 450°C, you'll need an external PT1000 converter (with output 0-10V or 0/4-20mA) and connect it to an analog input of [product_name] (0-10V, if your module supports analog inputs), or use an additional [product_name] analog module.

analysis.insight_summary: Users have identified that the [product_name] module cannot measure temperatures outside its fixed range of -50 to 200°C. To handle wider temperature ranges with PT1000 sensors, external conversion hardware is necessary, as the module’s measurement range cannot be configured or expanded.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects that the [product_name] module should offer settings or options to extend its measurement range to match the full capability of their sensor, from -50 to 450°C.
